name: label-ops
description: Print labels and receipts that actually scan — ZPL for Zebra label printers, ESC/POS for 58mm Bluetooth thermal printers, and GS1/Code128/Code39 check digits cross-validated against an independent encoder. Ships a deterministic benchmark.

interface.shortDescription: Labels that scan, receipts that read.
interface.longDescription: Label and receipt printers are fire-and-forget: neither answers, and both accept every byte you send whether or not anything prints. This skill covers the nine failures that reach an operator instead of a log — check-digit weight anchoring, Code 128 position base, ITF-14 padding, dots-per-mm on a 300 dpi printer, unescaped ZPL control characters, fields past the label edge, and UTF-8 sent to a code-page printer — with a ZPL builder that validates before the socket opens, an ESC/POS builder that encodes properly, and a benchmark whose barcode half is cross-validated against bwip-js.
defaultPrompt: Build a ZPL shipping label for this product and check it before printing
